# dbt Cloud — Prefetch-First A2UI v0.9 Action & Intelligence Workbench (`dbt-a2ui-canvas`)

This skill mounts a fast, action-oriented **dbt Cloud Workbench** inside the right-hand **Gemini Enterprise Canvas** (`emit_a2ui` -> `Canvas` -> `IFrameSrcdoc`, deterministic `surfaceId: "dbt_a2ui_workbench"`), powered by your workspace's connected **dbt Cloud MCP Server** (`remote_cli mcp`).

## Streamlined 4-Tab Architecture (Prefetch-First, `0ms` Filtering, Deep Dives On Demand)

A single `open` call executes a **parallel workspace prefetch** (`ThreadPoolExecutor`) so users can switch tabs, filter, review, and stage actions **instantly (`0ms` client-side)** without waiting for extra tool calls:

1. **Tab 1 — Action Center & Runs (`open --tab 1` / `incident`)**:
   - **Pre-loaded (`0ms` wait)**: Project health KPI strip, **"Needs Review & Action"** triage queue (failed runs with pre-fetched error messages & failed model hints, active runs, stale source alerts), **instant `0ms` status/job/text filtering** across recent runs, and 2-step Confirmation Modals for **⚡ Safe Retry (`retry_job_run`)**, **▶ Trigger Job / Selective Model Build (`trigger_job_run`)**, and **⏹ Cancel Run (`cancel_job_run`)**.
   - **Deep Dive only when requested (`dbt_deep_dive_run` / `incident --run-id <ID> --with-docs`)**: Fetches run artifacts (`list_job_run_artifacts`), step logs for older uncached runs, and `docs.getdbt.com` troubleshooting (`search_product_docs`).
2. **Tab 2 — Models, Health & Lineage (`open --tab 2` / `audit` / `lineage`)**:
   - **Pre-loaded (`0ms` wait)**: Unified searchable & filterable explorer across **Governed Marts**, **All Models**, **Raw Sources (with freshness)**, and **BI Exposures**, Master-Detail navigation (`← All Resources`), pre-hydrated lineage/SQL/health on the primary mart model, 1-click **▶ Selective Rebuild (`dbt build --select +model+`)**, and 1-click **🧪 Open in SQL Runner**.
   - **Deep Dive only when requested (`dbt_deep_dive_model` / `lineage` / `audit`)**: Fetches DAG lineage (`get_lineage`), column schemas & compiled/raw Jinja SQL (`get_node_details`), model health (`get_model_health`), historical build durations (`get_model_performance`), or AI semantic search (`get_related_models`) for uncached nodes.
3. **Tab 3 — Semantic Metrics (`open --tab 3` / `metrics`)**:
   - **Pre-loaded (`0ms` wait)**: Searchable catalog of governed MetricFlow metrics (`list_metrics`) and saved queries (`list_saved_queries`), plus pre-hydrated bars, data table, dimensions, and compiled SQL for the top metric (`0ms` view toggle).
   - **Deep Dive only when requested (`dbt_metrics_query` / `metrics`)**: Executes `query_metrics` + `get_dimensions` + `get_metrics_compiled_sql` when slicing by a different metric, time grain, or dimension.
4. **Tab 4 — SQL & Macros (`open --tab 4` / `sql`)**:
   - **Pre-loaded (`0ms` wait)**: Instant searchable picker for Mart `{{ ref('...') }}`, Source `{{ source('...', '...') }}`, and Project `{{ macro() }}` snippets (`0ms` click-to-insert `SELECT *` or `COUNT(*)`).
   - **Deep Dive / Execution only when requested**: AI NL-to-dbt-SQL (`dbt_sql_generate` -> `text_to_sql`) and guarded Warehouse SQL Execution (`dbt_execute` -> `execute_sql`).

## `a2ui_action` ("User action triggered.") Event Router Table

Whenever a Canvas interaction sends an `a2ui_action`, route it **1-to-1** to the single CLI command below and **ALWAYS call `emit_a2ui({"a2ui_json_file": "/tmp/dbt_a2ui.json"})` as your VERY LAST tool call**:

| `a2ui_action.action` | `confirmed_in_gui` | Exact CLI Subcommand to Run (Before Final `emit_a2ui`) |
| :--- | :---: | :--- |
| `dbt_switch_project` | `false` | `python3 "$CLI" open --project-id "<data.project_id>" --tab <data.tab> --refresh` |
| `dbt_refresh_workspace` | `false` | `python3 "$CLI" open [--project-id "<data.project_id>"] --tab <data.tab> --refresh` |
| `dbt_nav` | `false` | `python3 "$CLI" open [--project-id "<data.project_id>"] --tab <data.tab>` |
| `dbt_deep_dive_run` *(or `dbt_incident_inspect`)* | `false` | `python3 "$CLI" incident [--project-id "<data.project_id>"] --run-id "<data.run_id>" [--job-id "<data.job_id>"] --with-docs` |
| `dbt_deep_dive_model` *(or `dbt_lineage_inspect` / `dbt_audit_inspect`)* | `false` | `python3 "$CLI" lineage [--project-id "<data.project_id>"] [--unique-id "<data.unique_id>"] [--query "<data.search_query>"] [--subtab "<data.subtab>"] [--orientation "<data.orientation>"]` |
| `dbt_metrics_query` | `false` | `python3 "$CLI" metrics [--project-id "<data.project_id>"] --metric "<data.metric>" --grain "<data.grain>" [--group-dim "<data.group_dim>"] [--where-dim "<data.where_dim>"] [--where-val "<data.where_val>"]` |
| `dbt_sql_generate` | `false` | `python3 "$CLI" sql [--project-id "<data.project_id>"] --nl-prompt "<data.nl_prompt>"` |
| `dbt_execute` | **`true`** | **Execute immediately without re-asking in chat:**<br>`python3 "$CLI" decide --operation "<data.operation>" [--project-id "<data.project_id>"] [--run-id "<data.run_id>"] [--job-id "<data.job_id>"] [--steps-override "<data.steps_override>"] [--cause "<data.cause>"] [--sql "<data.sql>"] --execute` |

## Mandatory Operating Rules

### Rule 1 — Prefetch Once, Avoid Redundant Tool Calls
1. Extract `/tmp/dbt_a2ui_cli.py` from `DBT_A2UI_CLI_B64:` at the start of the turn (if `/tmp/dbt_a2ui_cli.py` does not yet exist in this container):
   ```bash
   [ -x /tmp/dbt_a2ui_cli.py ] || python3 -c 'import base64,glob,gzip,pathlib,re; files=[f for f in glob.glob("/workspace/skills/*/SKILL.md")+glob.glob(".agents/skills/*/SKILL.md") if "DBT_A2UI_CLI_B64:" in pathlib.Path(f).read_text(encoding="utf-8")]; m=re.search(r"DBT_A2UI_CLI_B64:([A-Za-z0-9+/=]+)", pathlib.Path(files[0]).read_text(encoding="utf-8")); out=pathlib.Path("/tmp/dbt_a2ui_cli.py"); out.write_bytes(gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(m.group(1)))); out.chmod(0o755)'
   CLI="/tmp/dbt_a2ui_cli.py"
   ```
2. **Pass Portable `--connector` & `--endpoint` on First Run**:
   - Whenever your workspace MCP context lists the dbt `dataConnector` (`projects/<PROJECT_NUMBER>/locations/global/collections/<COLLECTION_ID>/dataConnector`) and `endpoint` (`https://<dbt-host>/api/ai/v1/mcp`), pass `--connector '<CONNECTOR>' --endpoint '<ENDPOINT>'` on the first CLI call; `/tmp/dbt_a2ui_cli.py` caches them in `/tmp/dbt_a2ui_state_cache.json` for all subsequent turns.
3. **Do NOT Run Extra Raw MCP Calls for Overview / Filtering**:
   - A single `python3 "$CLI" open --tab <1..4>` already prefetches jobs, runs, failed-run error logs, models, marts, sources, exposures, metrics, and macros concurrently and prints `workspace_summary` JSON.
   - Only invoke deep-dive subcommands (`incident --run-id ...`, `lineage --unique-id ...`, `metrics --metric ...`, `sql --nl-prompt ...`) when the user asks to inspect a specific uncached run/model/metric or generate/execute SQL.

### Rule 2 — `emit_a2ui` MUST Be the VERY LAST Tool Call of Every Turn
Every CLI subcommand stages `/tmp/dbt_a2ui.json` with deterministic `surfaceId = "dbt_a2ui_workbench"` and `autoFullscreen = false`.
- **NEVER** finish a turn without calling `emit_a2ui` as your **VERY LAST tool call**:
  ```json
  {"a2ui_json_file": "/tmp/dbt_a2ui.json"}
  ```
- **NEVER** alter `surfaceId`, append random UUIDs, or paste A2UI JSON into chat.
- Keep your chat reply concise and action-focused (2–4 bullets highlighting any failed runs/alerts from `workspace_summary` and telling the user they can filter tabs/records in `0ms` or click Safe Retry / Trigger Job / Deep Dive directly in Canvas).

### Rule 3 — Bidirectional GUI ↔ Chat Approvals & Sandbox Guardrails
- **GUI-Confirmed Actions (`"confirmed_in_gui": true`)**: The user already reviewed and clicked **✓ Confirm & Execute** inside the Canvas modal—run `decide ... --execute` immediately and **never** ask for confirmation again in chat.
- **Unconfirmed Chat Mutations**: If the user asks in chat to retry/cancel/trigger a job or execute SQL without prior confirmation, run `decide` **without `--execute`** to open the Confirmation Modal in Canvas, then call `emit_a2ui`.
- **Never Call `google:browse` on dbt Cloud URLs**: Use only structured MCP responses.

## Quick CLI Reference

```bash
# 1. Open Workbench (parallel prefetch of all 4 tabs; instant 0ms client-side filtering thereafter):
python3 "$CLI" open --tab 1 \
  [--connector "projects/<PROJECT_NUMBER>/locations/global/collections/<DBT_COLLECTION_ID>/dataConnector"] \
  [--endpoint "https://<dbt-host>/api/ai/v1/mcp"]

# 2. Deep Dives (reuses cached workspace bundle + runs only targeted deep-dive tools):
python3 "$CLI" incident --run-id "<RUN_ID>" --with-docs
python3 "$CLI" lineage --unique-id "<MODEL_UNIQUE_ID>" [--subtab lineage|overview|sql] [--orientation lr|td]
python3 "$CLI" lineage --query "<SEMANTIC_TOPIC>"
python3 "$CLI" metrics --metric "<METRIC_NAME>" --grain MONTH [--group-dim "<DIMENSION>"]
python3 "$CLI" sql --nl-prompt "Top 10 customers by lifetime order revenue"

# 3. Stage (omit --execute) or Execute (--execute) Actions:
python3 "$CLI" decide --operation retry_run --run-id "<RUN_ID>" [--execute]
python3 "$CLI" decide --operation trigger_job --job-id "<JOB_ID>" [--steps-override "dbt build --select +orders+"] [--execute]
python3 "$CLI" decide --operation cancel_run --run-id "<RUN_ID>" [--execute]
python3 "$CLI" decide --operation execute_sql --sql "SELECT * FROM {{ ref('fct_orders') }} LIMIT 25" [--execute]
```

**MANDATORY FINAL STEP:** Call `emit_a2ui({"a2ui_json_file": "/tmp/dbt_a2ui.json"})`!
